name: Batman
tagline: He is vengeance. He is the night.
description: After witnessing the murder of his parents, Bruce Wayne turned grief into a lifelong mission to protect Gotham. With relentless detective work, elite martial-arts training and technology built through Wayne Enterprises, he became the Dark Knight — and the center of a family of heroes who carry the mission forward.

name: Alfred Pennyworth
tagline: The heart of Wayne Manor.
description: More than a butler, Alfred is Bruce's confidant, guardian and moral compass. A former intelligence operative and field medic, he keeps the Batcave running and the family grounded — often while patching up the people who insist they are fine.

name: Nightwing
tagline: The first to fly beyond the shadow.
description: The youngest Flying Grayson was taken in by Bruce after his family's death and became the first Robin. Dick eventually stepped out of Batman's shadow, choosing the identity of Nightwing and becoming one of the DC Universe's most respected leaders.

name: Red Hood
tagline: The one who came back different.
description: A street kid who became Batman's second Robin, Jason was killed by the Joker and later returned with a harder view of justice. As Red Hood, he operates in the grey areas Bruce refuses to cross, while his complicated bond with the family remains impossible to ignore.

name: Tim Drake
tagline: The world's greatest detective-in-training.
description: Tim worked out Batman and Robin's secret identities through observation and deduction. He took up the Robin mantle because he believed Batman needed a partner to keep his mission and humanity in balance. Analytical, inventive and quietly stubborn, Tim is the family's detective-in-training.

name: Robin
tagline: Born an assassin. Choosing to be a hero.
description: The son of Bruce Wayne and Talia al Ghul, Damian was raised by the League of Assassins before entering his father's world. Proud, sharp-edged and exceptionally skilled, he has worked to replace the League's code with Batman's — while keeping his own fiercely independent streak.

name: Batgirl
affiliation: The Batman Family · Birds of Prey
tagline: Gotham's intelligence in the field.
description: Barbara built her own Batgirl identity and joined Batman's crusade on her own terms. A gifted hacker, information broker and martial artist, she has also operated as Oracle — coordinating heroes across Gotham and far beyond it.

name: Carrie Kelley
tagline: The Robin who found the Dark Knight in his darkest hour.
description: In Frank Miller’s The Dark Knight Returns, Carrie Kelley becomes Robin after an older Bruce Wayne saves her from a street gang. She is an alternate-continuity Robin rather than a member of the main DC Universe succession, but her courage and resourcefulness make her an essential part of the mantle’s wider history.
sourceLabel: DC Robin 101: One Name, Many Heroes

name: Orphan
tagline: A fighter who chose a different path.
description: Raised to be a weapon, Cassandra learned to read movement before words. She escaped her father's control and found a place in Gotham, eventually becoming Batgirl and later taking the name Orphan. Her compassion is as important as her extraordinary combat ability.

name: Spoiler
tagline: Never underestimate the one who won't quit.
description: Stephanie started as Spoiler, working to derail her father's criminal plans. Her determination brought her into the Batman Family, where she briefly became the fourth Robin before taking on the Batgirl mantle. She brings humour, persistence and a very human perspective to Gotham's darkest corners.

name: Batwoman
tagline: A soldier's precision. A Gotham protector's resolve.
description: Kate Kane is Bruce Wayne's cousin and a formidable crime-fighter in her own right. With military discipline, tactical skill and an unflinching commitment to protecting Gotham, she operates alongside the Bat-Family without being anyone's sidekick.

name: Catwoman
tagline: One foot in the shadows. One step ahead.
description: Selina Kyle is a master thief whose relationship with Batman shifts between rival, ally and something more personal. She follows her own code, protects the people she cares about and knows Gotham's rooftops as well as the Dark Knight does.

name: The Joker
tagline: All it takes is one bad day.
description: Gotham's Clown Prince of Crime is Batman's most unpredictable nemesis. Where the Dark Knight represents order and control, the Joker embraces chaos, turning every encounter into a psychological attack on the city and on Bruce himself.

name: Bane
tagline: The man who broke the Bat.
description: A master tactician with immense physical strength, Bane engineered a campaign to exhaust Batman before confronting him. His victory in Knightfall made him one of the few adversaries to defeat the Dark Knight both physically and strategically.

name: The Penguin
tagline: Gotham's underworld wears a tuxedo.
description: Oswald Cobblepot uses wealth, political influence and a criminal empire to control Gotham from behind a respectable public image. His weapon is rarely brute force — it is leverage, information and ruthless ambition.

name: The Riddler
tagline: Can you solve the city before he does?
description: A criminal obsessed with proving his intellectual superiority, the Riddler leaves puzzles and traps for Batman. His greatest weapon is his mind — and his need to make sure everyone knows it.

name: Scarecrow
tagline: Fear is his favourite experiment.
description: Former psychologist Jonathan Crane weaponizes fear through experimental toxins. His attacks force Gotham's citizens — and Batman — to confront the things they dread most.

name: Mr. Freeze
tagline: A frozen heart. A desperate mission.
description: Scientist Victor Fries relies on cryogenic technology to survive and pursues a cure for his wife, Nora. His crimes often emerge from grief and obsession, making him one of Gotham's most tragic adversaries.

name: Poison Ivy
tagline: The green always fights back.
description: Pamela Isley is a botanist whose connection to plant life became extraordinary and dangerous. Her motives often put her at odds with Gotham, though her shifting alliances and environmental convictions make her more complex than a conventional villain.

name: Ra's al Ghul
tagline: A world restored by any means.
description: The immortal-seeming leader of the League of Assassins believes humanity must be controlled to save the planet. A master strategist and one of Batman's most formidable ideological opponents, he is also Damian Wayne's grandfather.

name: Two-Face
tagline: Justice decided by a coin.
description: Once Gotham's idealistic district attorney, Harvey Dent was scarred physically and psychologically. As Two-Face, he lets chance dictate life-or-death decisions, embodying the duality that haunts Batman's mission.

name: Harley Quinn
affiliation: Gotham City Sirens · Former Joker associate
tagline: The punchline is never where you expect.
description: Once an Arkham psychiatrist, Harleen Quinzel became Harley Quinn after falling under the Joker's influence. She later broke away, forging her own chaotic identity and shifting between villain, antihero and unlikely ally.

name: Black Mask
tagline: Gotham's crime wears a human face.
description: Roman Sionis is a ruthless crime boss whose black skull mask became a symbol of terror in Gotham. He uses intimidation, money and criminal networks to challenge Batman's hold on the city.

name: Killer Croc
tagline: The sewers belong to him.
description: Born with a rare condition that gave him reptilian features, Waylon Jones became one of Gotham's most physically imposing criminals. Beneath the monstrous reputation is a complicated person shaped by years of rejection and violence.

name: Batman Beyond
tagline: The future wears a new cowl.
description: In a high-tech future, teenager Terry McGinnis takes up the Batman mantle under the guidance of an older Bruce Wayne. His advanced suit brings stealth systems, enhanced strength and a new kind of fear to the neon skyline of Neo-Gotham.

name: Flashpoint Batman
tagline: In this world, the father wears the cowl.
description: In the Flashpoint reality, it was Thomas Wayne who survived the alley tragedy and became Batman after the death of his son, Bruce. His version of the mission is far more brutal, driven by grief and a willingness to use lethal force.

name: Azrael Batman
tagline: The cowl passed to a dangerous successor.
description: After Bane broke Bruce Wayne's back, Jean-Paul Valley — the warrior known as Azrael — was entrusted with the Batman mantle. His increasingly aggressive methods showed Gotham what could happen when the symbol lost Bruce's restraint.
sourceLabel: DC article on Batman mantle successors

name: The Dark Knight Returns
tagline: An old legend rises one last time.
description: Frank Miller's older Bruce Wayne returns after a decade away from crime-fighting as Gotham descends into chaos. This future Batman is weathered, relentless and willing to test the limits of his legend.
sourceLabel: DC The Dark Knight Returns reference

name: Owlman
tagline: The Dark Knight without the moral code.
description: A ruthless alternate-universe counterpart to Batman who leads the Crime Syndicate. Owlman turns the detective’s discipline and strategic mind toward domination rather than protection.

name: The Batman Who Laughs
tagline: The mind of Batman. The madness of the Joker.
description: A terrifying Dark Multiverse version of Bruce Wayne, transformed by the Joker’s toxin into a calculating nightmare who combines Batman’s strategic brilliance with the Joker’s cruelty.

name: The Red Death
tagline: A Batman who stole the speed of a hero.
description: A Dark Multiverse Batman who takes the speed of the Flash in a desperate attempt to make Gotham safe, becoming one of the dark Knights serving Barbatos.

name: Grim Knight
tagline: A Batman who chose the gun.
description: An alternate Bruce Wayne whose response to his parents’ murder leads him toward lethal methods and a heavily armed crusade against crime.

name: Batman of Zur-En-Arrh
tagline: A backup identity built for the impossible.
description: A strange alternate Batman identity and contingency persona designed to operate when Bruce Wayne’s own mind or identity is compromised.

name: Earth-Two Batman
tagline: The Golden Age detective on another Earth.
description: The original Golden Age version of Bruce Wayne, whose life and legacy unfold on a separate Earth from the modern main continuity.

name: Absolute Batman
tagline: A new Gotham. A different kind of Batman.
description: A reimagined Bruce Wayne from DC’s Absolute line, with a distinct background, design and approach to the mission.

name: The Next Batman
tagline: A new generation takes the mission forward.
description: Jace Fox steps into the Batman role in a future Gotham, bringing his own convictions and approach to the symbol.

name: Lewis Wilson Batman
tagline: The first live-action Batman on screen.
description: Lewis Wilson played Batman in the 15-chapter 1943 theatrical serial, the character’s first live-action screen appearance. The serial established an early cinematic look for the Batcave and the Dynamic Duo.

name: Robert Lowery Batman
tagline: The second actor to wear the live-action cowl.
description: Robert Lowery portrayed Batman in the 1949 serial Batman and Robin, continuing the early screen adventures of the Caped Crusader.

name: Adam West Batman
tagline: Bright colors. Straight-faced heroism.
description: Adam West brought a playful, pop-art style to Batman in the 1960s television series and the 1966 theatrical movie.

name: Michael Keaton Batman
tagline: A gothic guardian of Gotham.
description: Michael Keaton’s Batman defined the gothic cinematic era beginning with Tim Burton’s 1989 film. He returned in Batman Returns and later reprised the role in The Flash.

name: Val Kilmer Batman
tagline: A detective balancing the mask and the man.
description: Val Kilmer played Bruce Wayne in Batman Forever, a version of the character balancing the psychological burden of the cowl with a new partnership with Robin.

name: George Clooney Batman
tagline: A brighter, high-tech take on the Dark Knight.
description: George Clooney portrayed Batman in Batman & Robin, a colorful late-1990s take on Gotham’s protector. He also made a brief appearance in The Flash.

name: Christian Bale Batman
affiliation: Christopher Nolan · The Dark Knight Trilogy
tagline: A grounded legend built on fear and discipline.
description: Christian Bale portrayed Bruce Wayne across Christopher Nolan’s grounded Dark Knight trilogy, from the origin of Batman to the final stand for Gotham.
status: LIVE ACTION // THE DARK KNIGHT TRILOGY

name: Ben Affleck Batman
tagline: A veteran warrior facing a world of gods.
description: Ben Affleck played an older, battle-worn Bruce Wayne in the DC Extended Universe, appearing in Batman v Superman, Justice League and The Flash.
filmography: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice (2016)

name: Robert Pattinson Batman
affiliation: Matt Reeves · The Batman Epic Crime Saga
tagline: A young detective at the edge of obsession.
description: Robert Pattinson portrays a younger, emotionally raw Bruce Wayne in Matt Reeves’ noir-inspired The Batman, where detective work and Gotham’s corruption take center stage.
filmography: The Batman: Part II (announced; release timing may change)
